caption: The drawing features a detailed depiction of a single, historical-style dress shown on a neutral background. The main dress, rendered in a light brown or tan shade, has a high neckline with no collar, a fitted bodice with long sleeves, and buttons running down the front. The bodice is sculpted at the waist, creating a peplum effect over the hips. The skirt is full and falls to the floor, with the central front panel showing tight vertical pleats from waist to hem. The sides and back of the skirt are gathered and draped in soft folds, and there appears to be a subtle trim at the hem. To the upper right of the main dress, a smaller, line-drawn outline of the same dress is visible, viewed from the back, highlighting similar draped and gathered details of the skirt and the fitted lines of the bodice. The overall composition centers the main dress with ample space around it, and the background is a plain, off-white or beige color.
title: Dress
